internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the 40 occurrences is Form IV, in two shapes: 27 verbs and 13 active participles (al-mufliHun / al-mufliHin). Across all four grammatical deployments the meaning holds steady: perfect qad aflaHa = the good subject HAS come out well (believers 23:1, the self-purifier 87:14/91:9); negated lA yufliHu = the wrongdoer-class (mujrimun, Zalimun, kafirun, sAHir, liars-against-God) will NOT come out well; laAAallakum tufliHun = so that you MAY come out well (held out as the hoped-for result of taqwA, jihAd, dhikr, patience, shunning khamr/ribA); and al-mufliHun = the standing designation of those who have attained it. What varies is grammar and rhetorical polarity, not sense. The one sharp test, 20:64 (Pharaoh's sorcerers: 'and whoever gains the upper hand TODAY has aflaHa'), is worldly, time-bounded, and spoken by the condemned party, and the text rebuts it five verses later (20:69, 'the sorcerer does not yufliHu wherever he comes'). That token shows the bare word means only 'attain the aimed-at good outcome' — the salvation-coloring elsewhere is contextual, not lexical. Because the root never appears outside Form IV, this is honestly a claim about the Form-IV family, not about a deeper triangulated root sense.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: flH (Form IV) does NOT entail: (1) moral rectitude, righteousness, or eschatological salvation — proven morally neutral and worldly in 20:64 (condemned speaker, sheer domination, al-yawma); (2) causation/transitivity — no occurrence means 'make X prosper'; all 27 verbs are intransitive-stative, the subject attains it for itself; (3) any concrete/physical/agrarian 'split/cleave/till' sense — zero internal evidence, no Form I or maSdar in the corpus, so the etymological agrarian gloss is excluded; (4) the striving itself — flH is the hoped-for PRODUCT of taqwA/jihAd/dhikr (laAAallakum tufliHun), held apart from the commanded acts, i.e. succeeding, not doing; (5) a mere emotion ('be happy') — it is an objective attained standing (heavy scales, deliverance, prevailing); (6) automatic/guaranteed conferral — laAAalla (x11) and AAasA (28:67) mark it contingent even for believers/penitents; (7) gradation — it is whole-person class membership, no comparative falAH appears.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 20:64:7:1 — wa-qad aflaHa l-yawma mani staAAlA ('and today whoever gains the upper hand has aflaHa'), spoken by Pharaoh's sorcerers. It is (a) worldly and non-eschatological, (b) voiced by the very class elsewhere told lA yufliHu, (c) about sheer domination (istaAAlA), and (d) explicitly time-bounded by al-yawma, with an in-narrative rebuttal at 20:69:13:1 (lA yufliHu l-sAHiru Haythu atA). It REFUTES any account that builds salvation/righteousness into the lexeme, but CONFIRMS the thin nucleus 'attain the aimed-at favorable outcome / come out ahead' — hence it is an adversarial boundary that bounds the gloss, not a resistant seam that breaks unity.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge on one nucleus and on the decisive structural fact: the root is attested ONLY in Form IV (27 V + 13 N), so no Form-I contrast is available and no root-level generalization is licensable — the honest scope is the af'ala derivational family. Within that family the thin nucleus 'a person(-class) attains/settles into the aimed-at favorable end-state; intransitive, evaluative-total, binary, outcome-not-action, value supplied by context' is broad (40/40, ~24 surahs, Meccan+Medinan), tested across four grammatical/rhetorical frames (affirmed perfect, denied imperfect, hoped-for imperfect, nominal designation), and adversarially clean: the single hardest token (20:64) CONFIRMS rather than breaks it, and the in-narrative pair 20:64 vs 20:69 shows the Quran disputes the FACT (who actually comes out well, and on what timescale), never the MEANING. There is therefore no coherent resistant sub-class against the adopted (thin) claim, which warrants STRONG. The adversary's caution is honored by (a) refusing UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION given single-form attestation, (b) refusing to lexicalize the salvific overlay, and (c) flagging that neighbor-root distinctiveness (fwz/njw/rbH) cannot be tested from this packet. The formulaic repetition the adversary notes reduces the number of INDEPENDENT frames but does not introduce any resistant reading; the distinctive non-formulaic class (qad aflaHa, incl. 20:64) is exactly where the thin nucleus is most sharply and cleanly demonstrated.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Perfect qad/wa-qad aflaHa: a declared, accomplished attainment of the favorable end-state, predicated of a qualifying subject (the believers 23:1; whoever purifies himself 87:14; whoever purified it 91:9; whoever gains the upper hand today 20:64). This is the only non-formulaic, evidentially decisive class, and it is where the nucleus is sharpest: 20:64 shows the same perfect used for a purely worldly, time-bounded, opponent-voiced attainment, isolating 'come out ahead / attain the aimed-at outcome' as the bare lexical content.
clusters.classification_rationale: All four are the perfect finite verb (>afolaHa, V(IV)) with affirmative polarity and a person-class subject; no object. They share one sense; 20:64 differs only in the CONTEXTUAL horizon (worldly, al-yawma) not in the lexeme, confirming the nucleus.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Active participle al-mufliHun/al-mufliHin as a fixed nominal designation of the class that HAS attained the favorable outcome — 'the ones who come out well.' Predicated across diverse righteous subjects (the guided 2:5/31:5; the heavy-scaled 7:8/23:102; the hear-and-obey believers 24:51; enjoiners of good 3:104; seekers of God's face 30:38; the party of God 58:22; those guarded from the soul's stinginess 59:9/64:16; followers of the unlettered prophet 7:157; the Messenger and those who strove 9:88), plus the contingent AAasA an yakuna mina l-mufliHin (28:67).
clusters.classification_rationale: All 13 N(IV) agent-nouns; almost all the fixed clause ...ulA'ika humu l-mufliHun / fa-ulA'ika humu l-mufliHun, one mina l-mufliHin. The agent-noun naturally names the class that attains the same outcome the verb denotes; derivational specialization of one nucleus, not a second meaning. Restricted to the righteous, while the wicked receive only the negated verb — a polarity asymmetry that is BRIDGED (same nucleus, agent-noun vs negation), not a resistant class.

reconciliation.rationale: The aggregated claim is the THIN nucleus 'attain the aimed-at favorable outcome,' not the salvific overlay. Under it 20:64 is a straightforward worldly instantiation, and the immediately following 20:69 (lA yufliHu l-sAHiru Haythu atA) shows the Quran contests the sorcerers' PROSPECTS, not their vocabulary. Resistance dissolves once the salvific content is correctly attributed to context rather than the lexeme; 20:64 becomes the strongest confirming counterexample and is retained as an adversarial-boundary hard case, not a resistant seam.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, and adversary C) all read all 40 occurrences and converged on the same nucleus and the same decisive token; the divergence was only on grade/scope, which is resolved here by bounding scope to the derivational family (REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY) rather than by weakening the nucleus. Residual, non-falsifying caveat: distinctiveness from neighbour success-roots (fwz/njw/rbH) cannot be tested from this single-root packet and is left open in reopen_conditions.
candidate_root_contribution: flH is attested Quran-internally ONLY as the Form IV af'ala family (the finite verb aflaHa/yufliHu/tufliHu and its agent-noun al-mufliHun/al-mufliHin), and in this family it denotes, for a person(-class) subject and always intransitively, ATTAINING/COMING OUT WELL — settling into the aimed-at favorable end-state, coming out ahead. It names an outcome/achievement (the result the imperatives aim at), not an action, effort, or feeling; it is evaluative-total (the subject's whole standing) and binary/class-defining (one is of al-mufliHun or is denied it), never gradable, never transitive/causative, never concrete/agrarian. The moral, eschatological, or salvific value everywhere attached to it is supplied by the subject and context, NOT entailed by the lexeme.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 40/40 confirmed occurrences, all Form IV: 27 finite verbs (perfect >afolaHa x4, negated 3rd-person yufoliHu x11, 2nd-person tufoliHu x12) and 13 active participles (mufoliHuwna/mufoliHiyna). Uniformly intransitive, person-class subjects, no object anywhere; spread across ~24 surahs, Meccan and Medinan.
layer_attribution.derivation: The af'ala (Form IV) verb aflaHa and its agent-noun al-mufliH. Morphologically Form IV is causative, but here it is a fixed intransitive-stative achievement lexeme (subject attains for itself), not a productive causative; the agent-noun is the standard nominalization of that same intransitive attainment.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A single lexicalized derivational family. Root contribution licensable ONLY at the Form-IV level: 'a person(-class) attains/settles into the aimed-at favorable end-state; intransitive, evaluative-total, binary/class-defining, outcome-not-action, morally neutral in itself.' No root-level (cross-form) generalization is available because the root is unattested outside Form IV.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The pervasive salvific/eschatological/righteous coloring (heavy scales 7:8/23:102, Paradise 58:22, taqwA/jihAd/dhikr as means, the wrongdoer-classes as those denied) is CONTEXTUAL — carried by the subjects and surrounding narrative — and must NOT be promoted into the lexeme. 20:64 proves the bare word is neutral. This contextual layer stays at REPRESENTATIVE strength and is not the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 20:64, provisionally resistant to a thick salvific claim, is reconciled as CONSISTENT under the thin nucleus: it is a worldly instantiation, with al-yawma as scoping restrictor and 20:69 rebutting the fact not the meaning. The participle/negation polarity asymmetry (al-mufliHun only for the righteous; the wicked only ever lA yufliHu) is bridged as derivational specialization of one nucleus, not a second unbridged sense.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: None internal to the adopted thin nucleus — no occurrence resists it. The two live, non-falsifying limits are (1) single-form attestation, which forbids UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION and caps the honest scope at the Form-IV derivational family, and (2) neighbour-root distinctiveness (fwz/njw/rbH), untestable from this packet, holding demonstrated distinctiveness only to internal negative boundaries.

hard_cases.reason: The single strongest counterexample: a worldly, time-bounded (al-yawma), opponent-voiced (Pharaoh's sorcerers) affirmative use of aflaHa about sheer domination (istaAAlA), rebutted in-narrative at 20:69. It bounds the gloss by refuting any salvific/eschatological lexicalization while confirming the thin outcome-nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 20:64:7:1 wa-qad aflaHa l-yawma mani staAAlA is worldly, opponent-voiced, and al-yawma-time-bounded, with an in-narrative rebuttal at 20:69:13:1 (lA yufliHu l-sAHiru Haythu atA); it refutes building salvation into the lexeme and confirms the thin nucleus 'attain the aimed-at favorable outcome.'

hard_cases.reason: Atypical participle framing: AAasA an yakuna mina l-mufliHin makes membership among al-mufliHun merely POSSIBLE even for one who repented, believed, and did good, showing al-mufliHun is a contingent attainment rather than a fixed conferred title.

evidence_basis.statement: 28:67:11:2 frames membership among al-mufliHun with AAasA (only possibly), which — like the x11 laAAallakum tufliHun — marks flH as a contingent, non-guaranteed attainment even for believers/penitents.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is no final-RESISTANT occurrence under the adopted thin nucleus (it absorbs all 40, including 20:64), so this is not an unresolved/multi-class result. But there are genuine, evidence-derived hard cases that BOUND the claim: 20:64 as the adversarial boundary that refutes a salvific lexicalization, and 28:67 as a structural atypicality showing contingency of nominal membership. Each hard case's statement also appears as the strongest_counterexample (20:64) or as an occurrence-override note (28:67).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Form-IV occurrence of flH in which aflaHa/mufliH denotes the striving/action itself rather than an attained outcome, OR is genuinely transitive/causative ('make another prosper' with an object), OR carries a concrete/physical (split/cleave/cultivate) sense, OR shows real gradation/partial success — any of which would break the intransitive, outcome-not-action, binary, abstract nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The perfect and participle classes first (qad aflaHa 23:1/87:14/91:9/20:64 and al-mufliHun 2:5..9:88), since those carry the bare assertion; then the 2nd-person purpose clauses (laAAallakum tufliHun) to test whether flH ever fuses with the commanded act rather than naming its result.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each candidate, check QAC morphology (qac_pos, qac_verb_form) for any non-Form-IV or object-bearing frame, and read verse_text to confirm whether flH labels an outcome/standing versus an activity, and whether its subject is a person-class versus a thing.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do NOT count the contextual salvific/eschatological loading (heavy scales, Paradise, taqwA) as lexical content; strip subject-supplied morality and test the bare verb. Treat 20:64's worldly reading as the control that isolates the neutral nucleus, and treat formulaic repetition (ulA'ika humu l-mufliHun x10) as a single frame, not multiple independent confirmations.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a finding is confirmed, demote from STRONG and either narrow the nucleus (e.g. drop 'outcome-not-action' or 'intransitive') or split the derivational family into distinct classes; if a concrete/Form-I sense is admitted, the DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY claim can no longer stand as the root account.

reopen_conditions: If any Form I (falaHa), verbal noun/maSdar, or non-Form-IV derivation of ف ل ح is ever admitted to the corpus or a future packet, reopen: the present claim is explicitly bounded to the Form IV af'ala family and cannot license a deeper root sense or exclude a concrete split/cleave/cultivate sense — a Form-I contrast could sharpen or overturn the account.

If neighbour success/deliverance roots (fwz 'triumph', njw 'deliverance from peril', rbH 'profit') are packeted, reopen to test whether flH's 'attained favorable end-state' is genuinely distinct from them or collapses into a shared, undistinctive 'success' abstraction.

If a re-reading of 20:64:7:1 removes the restrictive force of al-yawma (so that the sorcerers' aflaHa is not scoped to a worldly 'today'), reopen the boundary between the worldly instantiation and the salvific overlay — the current partition of context-vs-lexeme depends on al-yawma being the scoping restrictor.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The strongest available refutation — 20:64 (worldly, opponent-voiced, time-bounded) plus its in-narrative rebuttal 20:69 — was run against the thin nucleus and did not break it: the token is absorbed as a worldly instantiation and, decisively, refutes the competing thick salvific gloss instead. distinctiveness_ok is asserted on the strength of four Quran-internally demonstrable negative boundaries (not causative, not agrarian, outcome-not-action, person-subject-intransitive) that make the nucleus non-vacuous rather than a fits-everything abstraction; no occurrence fails the account.
